description: This file declares the IpcFactory class, which implements the IIpcFactory interface for creating IPC server components related to application management and session management within the Rialto server IPC namespace.

classes.name: IpcFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating IPC server components such as application management and session management servers.

methods.name: createApplicationManagementServer
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an application management server, given a session server manager.

methods.name: createSessionManagementServer
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to a session management server, given playback, cdm, and control services.
